description: This file contains functions and type definitions for resolving Microsoft Teams allowlist entries, including parsing, normalization, and API interaction functions.

methods.name: stripProviderPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'msteams:' or 'teams:' prefix from a string.

methods.name: normalizeMSTeamsMessagingTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a raw messaging target string to a standard format or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeMSTeamsUserInput
methods.description: Removes provider prefix and normalizes user input string.

methods.name: parseMSTeamsConversationId
methods.description: Extracts conversation ID from a raw string if it matches the pattern.

methods.name: parseMSTeamsTeamChannelInput
methods.description: Parses a raw string into team and channel components.

methods.name: parseMSTeamsTeamEntry
methods.description: Creates an object with teamKey and optional channelKey from a raw string.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsChannelAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves a list of MSTeams channel allowlist entries to detailed resolution info.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsUserAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves a list of MSTeams user allowlist entries to detailed resolution info.
